events.verdict: Dort (OKC) and Curry (GSW) briefly engage and disengage and both players are able to move freely.
Hartenstein (OKC) establishes himself in Wiggins' (GSW) path and absorbs the contact during the pick.
Williams (OKC) legally contests Wiggins's (GSW) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Williams (OKC) places his off-arm against Schroder (GSW) and releases from contact.
Hartenstein (OKC) dislodges Schroder (GSW) from his rebounding position.
Payton II (GSW) establishes himself in a screening position in Joe's (OKC) path and absorbs the contact.
Hartenstein (OKC) collapses his forearm against his body as he jumps to contest Payton II's (GSW) dunk attempt and the contact is marginal.
Looney (GSW) places a hand on Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) back as he drives along the baseline and the contact is marginal.
Dort (OKC) extends both hands into Payton II (GSW) to commit a take foul.
Payton II (GSW) moves alongside of Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) path to the basket and the contact is marginal.
